message.content: Proposed 2 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: 按访谈为准：将时间线来源日期 13 March 改为 12 March，并在脚注中注明以访谈记录为准。

hunks.oldText: The timeline source records the event on 13 March 2024.
hunks.newText: The timeline source records the event on 12 March 2024.

hunks.oldText: \textsuperscript{1} The interview and timeline are both retained as sources.
hunks.newText: \textsuperscript{1} The interview and timeline are both retained as sources; the interview is taken as authoritative for the event date.
